scientific_integrity: General integral homotopy proof by explicit simplicial cofibers and path independence-complex recurrence. Sixteen mod-two computations corroborate, but are not the all-n proof.
scientific_limitations: For wheels with at least five rim vertices and exactly one edge deletion; unrestricted vertex-induced forests only. No equivariant or persistent-map assertion. Independent validation unperformed.
title: Spoke–rim edge-fault dichotomy for induced-forest complexes of wheels
